Specification: This module defines a trace-validation wrapper around a separate MultiNodeReads specification. It reads a JSON trace log, steps through it line by line using a local variable l, and constrains system actions so that each modeled action must match the next logged event, while also permitting preparatory backfilling steps that do not advance the log. The specification additionally asserts an environment assumption for TLC execution in breadth-first, single-worker mode, defines a temporal trace-following spec over <<l, vars>>, and includes temporal properties intended to detect whether the entire trace was matched and whether that matching was non-trivial.
